text:
marta_p: Heads up — intake for marigold-5.5b just came in from a partner. Model card: https://huggingface.co/marigold-5.5b
marta_p: License says "Research-only, no commercial use, no derivatives" and contributor CLA is unclear. Can we triage for hosting + quantization feasibility?

samir_r: Key first questions: allowed for paid hosted API? export control? any pretrained checkpoints with third-party restricted weights?

marta_p: Excerpt from the model card and partner notes:
```
License: Custom Research-Only (no commercial use, no derivatives)
Weights: Released by org X under ACL terms; contributors require attribution
Training data: mix of web-crawl + proprietary partner corpora (partner says redacted)
```

julian_d: :warning: Research-only + no derivatives = we cannot expose as a hosted commercial model. Options: (a) private deployment for partner under contract, (b) internal eval-only hosting. Need CLA and export-control statement. @nina_ops please check infra implications.

nina_ops: We can run in Dedicated/Private. For inference cost: FP32 baseline is ~4x A100-80GB for full throughput. Quantization options: int8 -> reduces memory but may change outputs. Drop-in config we use: 
```
quant: {
  backend: "awq",
  dtype: "int8",
  per_channel: true
}
```
Send eval set and we'll run a quant sweep on a small shard.

liz_chen: Started a quick int8 sweep on 1 shard. Quick result: summarization SARI -4.2, Rouge-L -1.6, more hallucinations in long contexts. Command I ran:
```
python run_eval.py --model marigold-5.5b --quant int8 --prompts eval/shard1.jsonl
```

samir_r: Proposed intake checklist (short):
- Legal signoff on license and data provenance
- Export-control ok
- Internal eval vs baseline (SLA thresholds)
- Quantization sweep with guard-rail thresholds
- Decide hosted vs private
I'll open an intake ticket and mark for partner-private-first.

legal-bot: Ticket LEG-2026-142 created: "marigold-5.5b license review". @julian_d assigned.

infra-bot: Job marigold-intake-quant-001 started on cluster-dev-2. Logs: /var/logs/marigold/intake-001.log (will update when done)

marta_p: Thanks — I'll upload eval + provenance zip to the intake ticket and ping when ready. Partner prefers private deployment; low priority for hosted.

julian_d: I'll check contributor agreements and export-control doc. If partner can sign a commercial license we can reconsider hosted.

nina_ops: Once legal clears, run full quantization sweep and also a latency/cost profile. I'll slot it into the next infra sprint.

liz_chen: Noted. I'll rerun with a larger eval set and include prompt perturbation tests.

samir_r: Sounds good. Keeping this as private deployment candidate. Will update ticket with prioritization and next steps. :thumbsup:
